Thousands of Google engineers use EGM, an open-source plugin, to draft specs with deep-context agents and stress-test them with zero-context subagents before writing code.

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
# DeepSeek Harness

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is an open-source agent harness developed by [DeepSeek AI](https://deepseek.com).

It is built on an **everything-is-a-plugin** architecture and powered by [Cordis](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis), whose design is described in [_A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability_](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.25512).

Documentation: [https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/)

## Developer preview

DeepSeek Harness is in _developer preview_ and iterating rapidly. **THERE WILL BE COMPATIBILITY-BREAKING CHANGES.**

Review the [safety notice](SAFETY.md) before running the project.

## Run

### Run from `npm`

Install `Node.js`, then run:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

The command starts the Web UI at `http://127.0.0.1:3080` by default and opens it in the default browser for a local launch. An SSH launch only prints the host URL because the SSH client or editor owns the local forwarded address. Pass `--no-open` to run the server without opening a browser. See [Web UI guide](docs/user/guide/index.md).

### Run from source

To run from a repository checkout:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
```

`pnpm run build` prepares the repository artifacts. `pnpm dsh web` uses those built artifacts without rebuilding.

## Community and support

## Why This Exists

Building a game solo with AI is powerful — but a single chat session has no structure. No one stops you from hardcoding magic numbers, skipping design docs, or writing spaghetti code. There's no QA pass, no design review, no one asking "does this actually fit the game's vision?"

**Claude Code Game Studios** solves this by giving your AI session the structure of a real studio. Instead of one general-purpose assistant, you get 49 specialized agents organized into a studio hierarchy — directors who guard the vision, department leads who own their domains, and specialists who do the hands-on work. Each agent has defined responsibilities, escalation paths, and quality gates.

The result: you still make every decision, but now you have a team that asks the right questions, catches mistakes early, and keeps your project organized from first brainstorm to launch.

# Orkas

**An open-source team of AI agents on your desktop — it turns your goals into finished work and keeps it moving.**

Orkas is an open-source (MIT), local-first multi-agent desktop app — an AI assistant that works as a team. Tell the **Commander** what you need: it finishes many tasks on its own, and for bigger work it plans the steps and brings in specialist agents along with the coding and personal agents you already use — **Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes-Agent** — to work on it together.

Orkas is built to keep a project moving, not just answer one prompt. A **project** holds the goal, rules, memory and files, so every new conversation picks up where the last one left off. **To-dos** split the work between people and agents, **Auto-advance** lets the team take on the next to-do by itself, and **scheduled automations** repeat routine work hourly, daily, weekly or monthly. All your data stays on your computer, and finished work comes back for your review — so you can trust Orkas with the ongoing work of your business.

**[⬇ Download Orkas for macOS & Windows](https://orkas.ai/download/?source=gh-orkas&entry_point=github_readme&download=1)** — free, with 500 credits for the built-in Orkas model, so you don't need an API key to start. # AI Cross Border Ecommerce Agent Toolkit

**AI 跨境电商运营智能体工具箱** · *Turn cross-border ecommerce SOPs into reusable AI Agent workflows.*

---

## 这是什么

把**跨境运营 SOP 里沉淀的经验**，翻译成**可复制的 AI Agent 工作流**：一个标准 Prompt + 一份输入模板 + 一个真实案例，任何人都能拿去直接跑出可发布的商品素材。

不是软件，不是 SaaS，只做四件事：

| 交付物 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 📘 运营方法论 | SOP 章节 → Agent 模块的完整拆解表 |
| 🧠 AI Prompt | 角色 / 任务 / 输入契约 / 输出契约 / 自检 |
| 🔁 工作流程 | 什么顺序跑、什么条件进入下一步、什么条件回流重改 |

**为什么做这个**：跨境运营的难点不是"不知道要做什么"，而是"知道但做不出稳定下限的产出"。同一个类目，老手写标题一次到位，新人写十遍还是堆词。这套工具箱的目标是把老手的**判断规则**结构化，让 AI 的产出稳定在老手水平线上。

# UniEmployee 数字员工平台

中文 | **[English](README.en.md)**

## 关于 UniEmployee

UniEmployee 是一套面向企业的**数字员工构建与运行平台**：把专业员工的工作经验、业务流程和判断标准，固化为可随时上岗、可配置、可审批、可观测的 AI 数字员工。通过 **Employee → Workflow/SOP → Skill → Connector → Tool** 五层能力模型，把大模型编排成能独立承担客服、销售、数据分析、HR、经营分析和网络运营等岗位工作的组织生产力，而不是零散的个人效率工具。

## 核心亮点

- 🧑‍💼 **数字员工构建与管理**：人设、模型、技能、工具、知识库、SOP、连接器全部页面化配置，运行时以 catalog 目录库为准；内置 8 个示例员工，支持员工分配、软删除与恢复。注意：`backend/employees/*.yaml` 是种子源，已有 catalog 库不会因修改 YAML 自动全量重播种。
- 🧩 **流程型技能与 SOP**：技能以 `SKILL.md` 规程沉淀（含触发条件与执行步骤），播种进 Store 供模型按需查阅，不凭记忆跳过；关键业务流程可用 StateGraph 状态机固化（含人工审批节点），保证多步流程准确执行。
- 📊 **数据分析与报告工作台**：小数（`xiaoshu`）拥有独立的 `/app/analyst` 工作台，支持数据库、附件表格、知识库和连接器数据源；SQL 查询采用 AST 级只读校验、表白名单、行数上限和服务端超时。分析报告与市场简报可通过 `REPORT_HTML_START/END` 通道渲染为可下载、可新窗口打开的 HTML 看板。
- 📚 **企业知识与业务本体**：已接入 FAQ、产品 Wiki、RAGFlow 多源知识与结构化企业本体；本体支持实体/关系管理、多跳路径、客户 360、故障影响分析以及经授权的对话写回，并保留来源和审计信息。
- 🔌 **连接器与工具生态**：通过 MCP 标准接入 CRM、新闻和 Playwright 浏览器自动化等外部系统（stdio 与 npx 两种形态），内置工单、搜索、知识库、文档生成、数据分析、本体查询等原子工具。
- 🧠 **跨会话长期记忆**：按 `(user_id, employee_id)` 隔离，落盘 Store 数据库，重启不丢；数字员工记住客户偏好并持续迭代。
- 📏 **超长对话自动压缩**：基于 deepagents 内置 `SummarizationMiddleware`，对话到达阈值（有模型上下文画像按 **85% 窗口比例**触发，否则按 **17 万 token**）时自动把旧消息折叠为摘要，完整历史落盘 `/conversation_history/{thread_id}.md` 可随时回读；消息一多先对旧工具参数瘦身、模型报超预算时自动压缩重试，长对话不爆上下文、不中断。
- 👀 **全链路可观测**：每次对话 / 审批恢复 = 一条 run，记录 LLM 与工具调用的输入输出、耗时、token 消耗，可回放定位。
- 🔐 **HITL + 多层安全护栏**：高风险动作触发流程中途中断，等待人工批准后自动继续；敏感词、工具白名单、内置文件/命令工具裁剪、SQL 只读校验和审计日志共同限制越权执行。
- ⏱️ **自动任务**：支持 cron 定时和 webhook 事件触发，执行链路复用对话运行时的记忆、护栏

# AI Cross Border Ecommerce Agent Toolkit

**AI 跨境电商运营智能体工具箱** · *Turn cross-border ecommerce SOPs into reusable AI Agent workflows.*

---

## 这是什么

把**跨境运营 SOP 里沉淀的经验**，翻译成**可复制的 AI Agent 工作流**：一个标准 Prompt + 一份输入模板 + 一个真实案例，任何人都能拿去直接跑出可发布的商品素材。

不是软件，不是 SaaS，只做四件事：

| 交付物 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 📘 运营方法论 | SOP 章节 → Agent 模块的完整拆解表 |
| 🧠 AI Prompt | 角色 / 任务 / 输入契约 / 输出契约 / 自检 |
| 🔁 工作流程 | 什么顺序跑、什么条件进入下一步、什么条件回流重改 |
| 📄 模板 + 案例 | 标准输入格式 + 真实产品的完整跑通记录（含复测数据） |

**为什么做这个**：跨境运营的难点不是"不知道要做什么"，而是"知道但做不出稳定下限的产出"。同一个类目，老手写标题一次到位，新人写十遍还是堆词。这套工具箱的目标是把老手的**判断规则**结构化，让 AI 的产出稳定在老手水平线上。

---

## 📎 原始资料来源

本仓库的方法论拆解自一份 38 页的内部运营手册，原文已随仓库提供：

📄 **[《Shopee 巴西站运营 SOP 总框架》（PDF · 38 页 · 29.7 MB）](./docs/电商运营SOP总框架.pdf)**

SOP 章节与 Agent 模块的逐条对应关系见 [`docs/00_Architecture_SOP_to_Agent.md`](./docs/00_Architecture_SOP_to_Agent.md)。

> ⚠️ **请注意**：这份 PDF 是**未经删改的原始内部手册**，其中包含平台明确禁止的做法（如刷单、诱导评价、虚假举报、参数虚标等）。
>
> **本仓库的 7 个 Agent 模块均未实现这些做法**：已识别项及其合规替代方案见 [`docs/03_Compliance_Guard.md`](./docs/03_Compliance_Guard.md)，未实现项逐条登记见 [`docs/05_SOP_Gap_Register.md`](./docs/05_SOP_Gap_Register.md)。
>
> 换句话说 —— **这份 PDF 是「原料」，不是「产品」。** 本仓库的产出物只包含合规路径。

---

## 🗂 Agent 全景

7 个模块，**全部已完成**。

| # | Agent | 中文 | 一句话职责 | 版本 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **01** | [Market Research Agent](./Agents/01_Market_Research_Agent/) | 市场分析 | 前置判断 / 容量 / 集中度 / 价格带（波谷检测）/ 配置组合 · **带计算脚本** | ✅ v0.4 |
| **02** | [Product Strategy Agent](./Agents/02_Product_Strategy_Agent/) | 产品策略 | 定位 / 配置 / 主推卖点收敛 / 定价模型 / SKU 四角色 · **净利率/盈亏价/券余量矩阵** · Skill

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
# florilegium

## Origin

The [Reddit post](https://www.reddit.com/r/LaTeX/comments/1xixznw/how_do_you_make_these_flowers_in_latex/)
asked how to make flowers like these in LaTeX. I don't know how the original was made. This
project is one possible way, and the way I did it uses hand-authored primitives with
randomized parameters, painted in Lua and placed by a procedural layout whose "fill the
unused space" part borrows a 1998 idea from the ornament literature.
It gets a similar look, but I explicitly tried to not replicate the original.

This project was made with the assistance of AI (Claude), and I'm sharing the
[process I used](PROCESS.md) to bring it to life.

## What it is

Procedurally generated Delft-blue floral page margins for LaTeX. No images, no imported
paths, no external assets: every petal, leaf and stem is a parametric curve computed in Lua
while the page is being written, painted like a watercolor, and written straight into the
PDF. Every page gets its own garden.

[Try it in your browser](https://kevinraymond.github.io/florilegium/). The playground sets a page
as a printer's proof, grows its margin with the same Lua, and hands it back as an SVG, a LaTeX
preamble or a Typst page setup.

*Six seeds of the grown composition. Same code, different seed — and the garden fills
whatever space the text leaves free.*

Two documents share one package, and two more (`showcase.tex`, `spread.tex`) show what
else it does:

| | `florilegium.tex` | `florilegium-grow.tex` |

# NOIR

**把「这台手机到底能泄露什么」变成一份可复现的报告。**

NOIR 是一个跑在电脑上的审计工具，通过 `adb` 读取已连接 Android 设备的应用清单、权限和 APK 里的网络端点，给出分类、风险评分和可执行的处置建议。它也可以在需要时调用 `jadx` 对单个应用做反编译和关键字检索。

> 定位：**审计与自我防护**。面向自己的设备、自己的应用、已授权的安全研究。

**官网 / Website:** https://verlintas.dev/noir/ · [中文](https://verlintas.dev/noir/zh/)

---

## 它做什么

1. **盘点**：列出所有「有网络权限 + 敏感权限」的应用，以及它们各自拿到了什么。
2. **抽取端点**：在设备端用 `unzip + strings` 从每个 APK 的 dex 里提取 URL，只回传几 KB，不把整包拉回电脑。
3. **分类与打分**：按包名和域名识别厂商（Xiaomi / Google / 腾讯 / 高德 …）与类别（遥测、广告、定位、输入法 …），结合权限和上报端点计算风险分。
4. **数据关联**：把权限翻译成"能拿到什么数据"（位置/通讯录/短信/通话/麦克风/相机/屏幕/应用列表/设备标识/文件/日历/账号），再和上报域名配对，得出"哪类数据可能流向哪里"。
5. **共享 UID**：识别 `android.uid.system` 这类共享用户，列出哪些包实际上共享同一套权限并集。
6. **清单层**：解析 `AndroidManifest.xml` 二进制 AXML，找出没有权限保护的导出组件、明文流量、备份、debuggable、targetSdk。
4. **给建议**：区分「可安全自动执行」「需人工确认」「不建议动」，并为每条动作生成回滚命令。
5. **必要时深挖**：`deep` 会把单个 APK 拉到本地，用 `jadx` 反编译后检索 `Runtime.exec`、`setApplicationEnabledSetting`、`DexClassLoader`、`MediaProjection` 等高风险调用。

## 它不做什么

- 不联网、不上传任何数据、不需要账号。
- 不修改系统分区，不需要 root。
- 不会自动卸载任何东西，除非你显式加 `--aggressive`。

---

## 第一次运行

```bash
noir
```

不带参数会进入向导：

1. 检查 `adb`，没有就**问你要不要自动下载**（`~/.noir/tools`）
2. 检查设备，没有就打印**开发者模式 / USB 调试的开通步骤**，然后**等你插线**（最多 180 秒）
3. 问一句「开始扫描?」，扫完直接出仪表盘
4. 问一句「执行这 19 条安全处置?」，`y` 就执行，并写好回滚文件

全程只会问两三个 y/n，其余都是自动的。

## 环境自检

# teardown

A Claude Code skill that turns any machine into a 3D simulator you can take apart.

Ask how something works. Claude builds it as one offline HTML page: the machine runs in the middle, every panel around it reads the real numbers, a button opens the part doing the work, and when nobody touches it the page tours itself.

| Telson SC-8 robotic scorpion | Pelagos OC-8 robotic octopus |
|---|---|
| ![Telson SC-8 robotic scorpion](docs/scorpion.gif) | ![Pelagos OC-8 robotic octopus](docs/octopus.gif) |

## Install

```
npx skills add elvarofficial/teardown -g -a claude-code
```

Then, once, in the installed folder:

```
npm install && npx playwright install chromium
```

You need Node.js 20 or newer. For the video you also need `ffmpeg`, and for the sound Python 3.

## Use

Ask Claude Code in plain words:

> Build me a simulator of a 4-stroke motorcycle engine I can take apart.

> How does a mechanical watch keep time? Show me as a simulator.

> Make a teardown of a hydraulic excavator arm and record a 20-second video of it.

Or open one of the 3 examples first:

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
reanimate

Reverse-engineer animations you like. Build your own on top.A Claude Code skill that works from a live site, a screen recording, an mp4, a gif or a Lottie file.

  
  
  
  

  

A short demo. Watch the full video.

A lot of good ideas start on someone else's site. Ask an agent to rebuild one from a link or a screenshot and it makes one pass, calls it done, and misses. It can't see the motion or tell how far off it is.

reanimate records the original, rebuilds it in your code, then records the copy the same way and compares the two. Each round shows what's still off, so the agent keeps going until the numbers match. You end up with a close starting point to make your own.

  

Three cards from stripe.com. Top: the original. Bottom: the copy, filmed the same way.

## Install

```sh
npx skills add NiazMorshed2007/reanimate -g
```

The [skills CLI](https://skills.sh) asks which agents to set up; add `-a claude-code` to skip the question. Then, in Claude Code, say what you want, where it is and where it should go:

/reanimate this loader, 0:03 to 0:05 of ~/Downloads/loader.mov
/reanimate the card hover in this gif, match it exactly

```

Needs [Bun](https://bun.sh) 1.1 or later, on macOS or Linux (Windows is untested). The first run installs a static ffmpeg into the skill's folder and Playwright's C

UNCUT

UNCUT is a tiny coding-agent harness for shell pipelines, CI jobs, containers, and agent experiments. It deliberately has no TUI, telemetry, plugin system, background agents, automatic retries, or context compaction.

The entire conversation is sent on every model call. File contents and combined command output are never truncated by UNCUT. - **Lossless by default.** No summarization, pruning, sliding windows, or silent output caps.

- **Provider neutral.** Works with OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoints, including local servers.
- **Resumable.** Optional append-only JSONL sessions preserve every message and tool result.
- **Forkable.** 837 lines of implementation Go, four tools, one provider protocol, one agent loop, MIT license.

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
An agent harness for learning.

  Download ·
  How it works ·
  Documentation ·
  Issues ·
  Discord

LearnHarness uses AI agents to plan and teach lessons from your current understanding to your goal. It builds a detailed picture of what you understand and how you reason. That picture is updated as you learn.

Instead of just giving you an explanation, it uses your answers and thinking to decide what you need next. Teaching builds understanding one reasoning step at a time. Practice makes it usable. A persistent knowledge graph carries it across sessions.

## How it works

1. **Measure.** Before teaching, the agent finds where your understanding ends on each part the lesson depends on. Your answers, confidence, and thinking show it where to start.
2. **Plan.** It works out a dependency map from that starting point to your goal. You can see the plan, and the lesson adapts when your understanding turns out different.
3. **Teach.** Each step builds on something you already understand. You predict, get an explanation, and check your understanding. Confusions are repaired before anything is built on them. The aim is for the goal to feel obviously true, not merely familiar.
4. **Practice.** Separate sessions pose varied problems that require the right knowledge to come to mind without being named first. Problems and hints adapt to your reasoning.

Ask Codex, Claude Code or any coding agent to make a film. It writes the film as web pages, and Studio, a local
editor that runs in your browser, shows it taking shape. Then change anything you like, by hand or by asking.

- **One HTML file.** `film.html` cuts animated web pages, footage, pictures and sound together on tracks, styled

- **One function.** Each shot is a web page that draws any moment with `frame(t)`, using anything a browser can
  draw: three.js, WebGL, canvas, SVG, CSS, GSAP, video and more. No framework (like Remotion or HyperFrames): one
  function is enough.
- **One real editor.** Move, scale and rotate any element inside a page, change its text, color and style; place,

# leanrea

**One 8 KB skill file that does what [REA](https://github.com/morluto/rea) does: no MCP server, no 207 tools, no setup.**

REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) puts an MCP layer between your agent and tools it can already use: asar, otool, nm, `go version -m`, jadx, apktool, Ghidra, tshark, binwalk, sqlite3. leanrea drops that layer. It tells the agent which command is fastest for each kind of target, gives it ready-to-paste recon commands, and lists the traps that REA's code handles for you. The agent then runs the real tools itself.

|---|---|---|
| What gets installed | 25 MB npm package + MCP server | one `SKILL.md` |

Claude Code headless (`claude -p`), Sonnet 5.5, macOS arm64. 4 reverse-engineering tasks × 3 reps × 3 arms, with the arms run side by side. Answers are graded against hand-made keys.

| REA (MCP + its skill) | 627 s | $3.36 | 124 | 5.93 M | 75/75 |

**Ears for coding agents.**

[**Watch the 22 s launch film**](https://github.com/Leonxlnx/earshot/releases/tag/v0.1.0) - every sound in it was made

professional launch films. It runs locally on CPU, as a CLI, a Python API and an MCP server.
